import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    arr = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    k = int(next(it))
    arr.sort()
    best = 0
    start = 0
    while start < n:
        end = start + 1
        cnt = 1
        while end < n and arr[end] - arr[start] <= k:
            cnt += 1
            end += 1
        if cnt > best:
            best = cnt
        start += 1
    sys.stdout.write(str(best) + "\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
